matter_background.original: By a final decree dated 25th October 2010, entered in District Court of Pugoda Partition Case No. 582/P the land and premises bearing Assessment No.45, Colombo Road, Púgoda depicted as Lot 1 in Plan No.173 dated 27th February 2009 made by K.D. Silva Licensed Surveyor of the land called Annasiwatta in extent of 38 perches was allotted to one Gamini Jayasinghe. By Deed of Transfer No.2778 dated 10th March 2011 attested by A. Kamala Notary Public of Gampaha, the said Gamini Jayasinghe sold and conveyed the said land and premises bearing Assessment No.45, Colombo Road, Pugoda to one Kamala Silva. Kamala Silva upon Deed of Gift No.5634 dated 18th April 2011 attested by V. Gunatithilaka Notary Public of Gampaha gifted the said land and premises unto her only son Kasun from her ex-husband Thilak: Kamala died on 07th July 2011 leaving her second husband Namal Silva and two children namely Sarathi and Amal. Kasun died on 03rd May 2013 intestate and unmarried and his estate was duly administered in District Court of Pugoda in Testamentary Proceeding No.1589/2013/T. The said proceedings-were terminated on 10th February 2014 and the Administrator's Conveyance No.6231 dated 21st March 2014 attested by V. Gunathilaka Notary Public was executed by Thilak who was the Administrator of the estate of his late son Kasun. Thilak died on 03rd March 2017 intestate. Thilak was previously married to Sumana and had two children namely Sunil and Lalith. On 08th August 2018 Sarathi met with an accident and died interstate and issueless leaving her husband Sena.
